notes.title: Wishlist Stretch Goal Update!
notes.notes:
You’re all incredible! Star Garden has hit 2,600 wishlists on Steam in just 24 hours! To celebrate, four characters will be unlocked for FREE on all platforms at launch. We’ll reveal the designs for the two new characters soon. Let’s hit that final stretch goal together!
